'Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. / **Surge** - If this deals more than 1 damage, you may return an aura with Sigil in its name from your graveyard to your hand.' Wizard Action (Oscilio blitz deck).

CLAUSE 1 IMPLEMENTED: PLAY + DEAL_ARCANE amount 1 target OPPONENT. The handler (effect_types.py:1188-1219) resolves the player via _damage_target_player (effect_types.py:907-931), which maps OPPONENT/HERO/TARGET_HERO alike to the opposing hero - 'target hero' from this card's seat. Spelling copied from shipped arc/lesson_in_lava_yellow.json and omn/dashing_flashfoot_yellow.json for the same wording. Damage goes through the canonical deal_damage primitive, so prevention/replacement and the damage tally all see it.

SURGE CLAUSE NOT AUTHORED - inexpressible today, deliberately left off rather than authored dead. Same verdict as .drafts/destructive_aethertide_blue.json, whose printed Surge rider is the identical 'If this deals more than 1 damage' family; every route re-verified against source this session:
(1) The SURGE condition exists (condition_types.py:748-753) but calls surge_check(e, amount), which reads event.data['damage'] (ability_keywords.py:715-718). An effect-level gate on this PLAY ability evaluates under the play-resolution event, which carries no damage payload, so the gate is False in EVERY state.
(2) A TRIGGERED ON_DEAL_DAMAGE payoff cannot hear the damage either: _dsl_deal_damage_listener (engine.py:1742-1772) is registered on the 'damage_dealt' event and returns immediately unless state.combat.attack_card exists - COMBAT damage only, dispatched to the attack card and attacker's hero. This card's effect damage flows through effect_keywords.deal_damage's generic 'damage' event, which has no DSL listener at all (full registration census engine.py:1774-1799 confirms no bridge).
(3) No condition compares a damage MAGNITUDE to a threshold. LAST_DAMAGE_DEALT (state._last_damage_dealt, set post-prevention at effect_keywords.py:527) and DAMAGE_DEALT_THIS_TURN are amount EXPRESSIONS only (effect_types.py:76-77, 121-129); grep of condition_types.py finds no condition reading either, so 'more than 1' cannot be tested anywhere.
It becomes authorable as TRIGGERED ON_DEAL_DAMAGE + conditions [SURGE amount 2] + MAY{SEARCH_GRAVEYARD filter_types [Aura], name_contains Sigil} once a DSL bridge dispatches ON_DEAL_DAMAGE for ability damage (or a magnitude condition exists). The payoff half itself is ready: SEARCH_GRAVEYARD (effect_types.py:1835-1892) reads filter_types/name_contains, defaults destination hand, and is fail-to-find optional via ask_optional - exactly 'you may return an aura with Sigil in its name from your graveyard to your hand'.

'Surge' in printed_keywords needs NO authoring: build_keyword_triggers explicitly passes it as card-specific (triggers/triggers.py:400-401), so the DB keyword does nothing by itself and there is no double-grant risk.
